from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/schema")

@router.get("/tenants/{tenant_id}/openapi.json")
async def get_tenant_custom_openapi(
    tenant_id: str,
    registry: TenantSchemaRegistry = Depends(get_schema_registry),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    tenant_config = await registry.get_tenant_configuration(tenant_id)
    if not tenant_config:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Tenant schema registration not found")

    custom_routes = await registry.get_private_extension_routes(tenant_id)
    base_schema = get_openapi(
        title=f"Tenant API - {tenant_config.name}",
        version="1.0.0",
        routes=custom_routes
    )
    base_schema["info"]["x-internal-webhook-endpoints"] = tenant_config.internal_webhook_urls
    base_schema["info"]["x-tenant-signing-key-id"] = tenant_config.signing_key_identifier
    return base_schema

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/schema")

@router.get("/tenants/{tenant_id}/openapi.json")
async def get_tenant_custom_openapi(
    tenant_id: str,
    registry: TenantSchemaRegistry = Depends(get_schema_registry),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if current_user.tenant_id != tenant_id and not current_user.is_superuser:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized to access private OpenAPI specifications for this tenant")

    tenant_config = await registry.get_tenant_configuration(tenant_id)
    if not tenant_config:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Tenant schema registration not found")

    custom_routes = await registry.get_private_extension_routes(tenant_id)
    base_schema = get_openapi(
        title=f"Tenant API - {tenant_config.name}",
        version="1.0.0",
        routes=custom_routes
    )
    base_schema["info"]["x-internal-webhook-endpoints"] = tenant_config.internal_webhook_urls
    base_schema["info"]["x-tenant-signing-key-id"] = tenant_config.signing_key_identifier
    return base_schema
